note: Republic Bank (Guyana)'s Savings Plus page: its service fees guide charges only for ATM and over-the-counter withdrawals, with no fee for keeping the account; per-withdrawal charges aren't modelled.

sources.title: Republic Bank (Guyana), Savings Plus
sources.said: Service Fees Guide ... GY$70 per withdrawal at the ATM ... Point-of-Sale transactions are Free of charge when done on RB(G)L terminals ... Withdrawals performed over the counter – less than or equal to GY$200,000 – GY$300 per withdrawal
